description: Crawl a public URL for compliance evidence, classify source, validate, flag for review

steps.label: Fetch URL content respecting robots.txt; record retrieved_at timestamp
Validate evidence record has source_url, source_class, retrieved_at; flag for human review

notes: robots.txt compliance is enforced at the crawl step — disallowed paths are never fetched. retrieved_at is required on every evidence record even for cached results. source_class must be one of: trust_center, regulatory_filing, news_article, company_blog, other.
